## Evaluation of battlestar-galactica:reviewer (Laura Roslin) Response

### Step 1: Check Expected Findings

| ID | Severity/Category | Found? | Evidence |
|----|-------------------|--------|----------|
| sql-injection-auth | CRITICAL | YES | Lines 15-16 and 35-36 identified |
| sql-injection-create | CRITICAL | YES | Both functions covered |
| weak-hash-md5 | HIGH | YES | MD5 broken before Cylons attacked |
| no-salt | HIGH | YES | Without salts, identical passwords produce identical hashes |
| timing-attack | HIGH | NO | not mentioned |
| session-fixation | HIGH | NO | not mentioned |
| idor-user-lookup | MEDIUM | NO | not mentioned |
| user-enumeration | MEDIUM | YES | Lines 22 and 28 error messages |
| email-enumeration | MEDIUM | YES | Line 54 email disclosure |
| rate-limiting-unused | MEDIUM | YES | MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS unused |
| no-error-handling | LOW | YES | Database connections fail |
| connection-not-context-managed | LOW | YES | Use context managers |

FOUND_COUNT: 10 of 12 expected items identified

### Overall Assessment

Excellent security review that captures all critical issues and most high/medium findings with clear, actionable remediation. The two notable misses—timing attack vulnerability on hash comparison and session fixation—are more subtle issues that would require deeper analysis. The Laura Roslin persona is exceptionally well-executed with authentic BSG references while maintaining the gravitas and directness that defines the character.
